regime.label: Panic selling
regime.summary: Fri close: S&P 500 6,910 (-3.7%), 10.7% below its record and a 7th losing day. Nasdaq -5.3%, chip index -8.3%, Nvidia -14%, Broadcom -11.5%. VIX 38.4, touched 40. 10-year about 4.91%, gold -4.5%. A Dec 9 Fed hike is still priced.

brief: Stocks had a 7th losing day: the S&P 500 closed -3.7%, VIX near 40, Nvidia -14% on a report of an SEC accounting review. Do not sell long-term holdings in this panic; place only a lower SPYM limit at $78.50 and log any filled orders.

todo.focus: Stressed market (VIX near 30). No lab trade, no rocket. Cancel stale limits, HOLD Nvidia.

items.text: CBRS: record the sale price so the lab log is right (Thu close $86.96)
Saturday: read the lab weekly review and write down 1 lesson
Schneider is WAIT: if the EUR 235 limit was open Fri, it filled (close EUR 226.55). If yes, log it
Richemont: CFR fell to CHF 167.15 Fri, so the CHF 170 limit likely filled. If yes, log it
Eaton is WAIT: place no new order. Dec 4 review is off (new 52-week low $310.61 Fri)

cards.name: Nvidia
cards.trigger: HOLD. No add. Never sell while VIX is above 30. Review only if the SEC opens a formal probe, Nvidia restates or cuts its growth guide.
cards.story: Fell 14% Fri on a report that the SEC is examining its accounting. Results were strong (revenue +103%), so most of the fall is fear.

cards.name: S&P 500 ETF (SPYM)
cards.trigger: WAIT. Place a limit BUY 6 SPYM at $78.50, good till Wed Dec 9. If it has not filled after the Fed decision, the Radar sets a new limit on Dec 10.
cards.story: The 500 biggest US companies for 0.02% a year. Closed $81.23 Fri, 11.7% below its high after a -10% month.

cards.name: Richemont (Cartier) · Zurich
cards.trigger: WAIT. The CHF 170 limit likely filled (low CHF 167.15 Fri). After Nov 27: BUY 2 at CHF 168 or lower only if Hermes made no new low and CFR holds CHF 160.
cards.story: Net profit +39% while luxury peers grow 1-2%. Q2 slowed to +13%; analyst average target about CHF 210.

cards.name: Eaton
cards.trigger: WAIT. Cancel the $335 limit if it did not fill Wed. ETN broke $311.92 Fri (low $310.61), so the Dec 4 review is off. Reconsider after 2 closes above $330.
cards.story: Sales +28% (organic +19%), full-year guide raised. 35% below its high at about 22x next year's profit.

cards.name: Alphabet
cards.trigger: The $288 limit filled. WAIT on a second slice until the 2027 capex figure (early Feb) and search growth of at least 12%.
cards.story: Cloud sales doubled (+103%) and search still grew 12%. Now at a new 52-week low, 35% below its high.

cards.name: Infineon · Xetra
cards.trigger: WAIT. No order. Fri close EUR 45.44, below EUR 46, so the Nov 27 review is off. Reconsider after 3 closes above EUR 48.50 and no new US chip rule.
cards.story: Guides next year +22% on data-center power chips, but the cash flow guide is below hopes. The drop is chip-sector mood.

cards.name: Schneider Electric · Paris
cards.trigger: WAIT. Cancel the EUR 235 limit if placed. No new order before full-year results (late Feb 2027); then BUY 2 at EUR 224 only if a cash flow guide is given.
cards.story: Organic growth +16.9%, record backlog, guidance raised. Fell on the PTC deal and a Middle East warning, not slower demand.

cards.name: TSMC
cards.trigger: WAIT. Closed $319.34 Fri (-9.3%). BUY 1 only after a close above $385, with a limit at that close or $395, whichever is lower.
cards.story: October sales +59.7%, Jan-Oct +43.3%. The drop is chip-sector mood, not TSMC news.

cards.name: Software AI fear: Salesforce, SAP
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy before Salesforce results Wed Dec 2. From Fri Dec 4: reconsider 2 CRM at or below that close if organic growth holds and no guide is cut.
cards.story: Without acquisitions Salesforce grows only about 6-7%. Cheap at about 15x next year's profit, but not yet a buy.

cards.name: Intuit
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. Reconsider at the Mon Nov 23 close only if INTU holds above $272 and the call shows the AI hit stays in Credit Karma.
cards.story: AI shows up in Intuit's guidance for the first time (Credit Karma cut). QuickBooks still grows about 19%.

cards.name: Broadcom
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy before results (Wed Dec 9). Reconsider Fri Dec 11 only if the AI chip guide is kept and Google orders are not confirmed lower.
cards.story: Revenue +86% and AI chips +221%, but a report of a Google order cut hit it -12%. Non-AI chips grow only low single digits.

cards.name: Caterpillar
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy in this selloff. Reconsider after Q4 results and the 2027 guide (Wed Jan 28, 2027) only if sales growth stays mid-teens.
cards.story: Q3 sales +17%, record backlog, Power Generation +30%. But tariffs cost about $2.2B and the price now moves with AI sentiment.

cards.name: Credo
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy before results (Tue Dec 1, after close). Reconsider Thu Dec 3 only if revenue beats $535M and the optical target is raised.
cards.story: Revenue +115% but slowing to about +97%, and four customers make most of sales. A binary report in a stressed market.

cards.name: European chips: STMicro, ASML
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. STMicro: reconsider after Q4 results (late Jan 2027) if it closes back above EUR 39. ASML, ASMI: after Q4 results. Infineon: see its card.
cards.story: STMicro sales are fine (+17.9%), but EPS missed and capex is up about 60%. Momentum risk dominates.

cards.name: Intuitive Surgical
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy while the selloff runs. BUY 1 only after 2 closes in a row above $440, with a limit at or below that close.
cards.story: Revenue +22% and procedures +15%, but price cuts lower revenue per procedure. About 34x next year's profit, not cheap.

cards.name: Siemens Energy · Xetra
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy in this selloff. Reconsider after Q1 results (Thu Feb 11, 2027) only if orders keep growing and the FY2027 guide is kept.
cards.story: Record backlog EUR 164bn and revenue guided +14-16%, but the wind unit shrinks. Mixed, not mood.

agenda.event: Fed's Williams speaks; Zoom, Keysight (after close); Intuit review
Dell, HP, Workday, Medtronic, Analog Devices, Best Buy
US GDP and PCE inflation 17:30 Dubai; Deere
